_comment: Manual escape hatch for distributions that are officially ANNOUNCED but that no free API exposes.
This is mainly needed for Fidelity mutual funds (FXAIX/FSKAX), where Fidelity publishes ex/pay dates and
estimated year-end capital gains on fidelity.com but offers no public JSON feed.
Anything listed here is rendered as 'Announced' (confirmed), NOT as a projection, so only add real,
published figures and cite the source URL.
Entries are matched to generated projections by symbol + ex_date (within 20 days) and override them.
Delete entries once they have actually been paid - the pipeline will pick them up from Yahoo automatically.

announced.note: EXAMPLE ROW - amount is null so it is ignored. Replace amount with Fidelity's published figure to promote this to 'Announced'.
